name: std::shared_ptr<T>::unique
intro: Checks if *this is the only shared_ptr instance managing the current object, i.e. whether use_count() == 1.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if *this is the only shared_ptr instance managing the current object, false otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function was deprecated in C++17 and removed in C++20 because use_count() == 1 is meaningless in multithreaded environment (see Notes in use_count).
